title: Execution under an extended program
statement: Fix limits, a program $P$, a depth $d$, a statement $s$, states $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$, and a cost $c$. If $s$ executes from $\sigma$ to $\sigma'$ at depth $d$ under $P$ with cost $c$, then for every program $R$, it also executes with the same states, depth, and cost under the concatenation of $P$ and $R$.
hypotheses_covered: Execution of $s$ from $\sigma$ to $\sigma'$ at depth $d$ under $P$ with cost $c$
